claims.text: Effusion w pericarditis: mgnt as pericarditis.
claims.quote: When pericardial effusion is associated with pericarditis, management should follow that of pericarditis.
First-line therapy for uncomplicated pericarditis is aspirin

claims.text: Sxtomatic effusion w/o inflam, or anti-inflammatories fail: consider drainage.
claims.quote: When a pericardial effusion becomes symptomatic without evidence of inflammation or when empiric anti-inflammatory drugs are not successful, drainage of the effusion should be considered.
